name: 日付範囲と請求項目を示すBilling History表
prompt: Create a wide Japanese billing history table for a Slack workspace settings page, based on the supplied reference crop. Include the title 請求履歴, a date-range control, and four columns: 日付, 項目, 請求額, 状態. Preserve only the visible source row: 06/15/2024, 無料トライアルを開始, 明細書 #7266984523495. Leave charge and status cells blank because the reference does. Use white surfaces and restrained slate controls; use the official Lighthouse gradient (135deg #174C36, #1F6444, #2D8F5E) only for a small section marker or selected action. No tinted backgrounds, color wash, glow, or invented values. Keep the table legible and compact, with no surrounding page navigation.
reviewNotes: Initial candidate preserves source values but has excess vertical canvas relative to the 1137:204 source region; superseded by v2.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
